span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Realising compact Hausdorff spaces as quotients of Stone spaces by closed equivalence relations, and then splitting those equivalences as idempotents inside the allegory, transports the Stone-space/boolean-algebra equivalence up to the compact Hausdorff/de Vries level.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: One of the intermediate categories the construction produces has badly behaved isomorphisms.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: In one of the categories used, two objects can be isomorphic while differing in cardinality, so the word does not carry its usual force there.
span.note: what this limits: a statement that two objects of StoneER are isomorphic: isomorphism there is not a structure-preserving bijection, and two objects may be isomorphic even without sharing the same cardinality
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The composition operation in the classical dual category is not the usual function composition, which is the drawback the paper exists to remove.
span.note: what this limits: any argument that composes morphisms in de Vries' original dual category DeV: composition there is not usual function composition, whereas in the alternative proposed here it is usual relation composition
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The direction chosen for the morphisms is declared a matter of taste, with the opposite convention giving a dual statement of the same result.
span.note: what this limits: the direction in which this equivalence is stated: the authors call the choice of direction a matter of taste and note the result can equally be stated as a dual equivalence

span.label: Stone duality lifts to an equivalence between Stone spaces with closed relations and boolean algebras with subordination relations.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Splitting the equivalences (closed equivalence relations) in the allegory of Stone spaces and closed relations produces a category equivalent to compact Hausdorff spaces with closed relations.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Splitting the equivalences on the algebraic side produces a category equivalent to de Vries algebras with compatible subordination relations.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Compact Hausdorff spaces with closed relations are equivalent to de Vries algebras with compatible subordinations, settling the open problem of finding a de Vries-style dual for KHausR.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: That equivalence cuts down to an equivalence between compact Hausdorff spaces with continuous maps and the wide subcategory DeVF of de Vries algebras whose morphisms obey two extra conditions, giving an alternative to de Vries duality.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The gain over classical de Vries duality is that composition of morphisms becomes ordinary composition of relations rather than the ad hoc de Vries composition.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The equivalence is realised concretely by sending a closed relation R to the subordination on regular opens defined by U S V exactly when R maps the closure of U inside V.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Isomorphisms in the intermediate categories are badly behaved: two S5-subordination spaces can be isomorphic in StoneER while their underlying Stone spaces differ in cardinality.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: In the de Vries algebra category DeVS, by contrast, every isomorphism is a structure-preserving bijection.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The new category DeVF is dually isomorphic to the classical category DeV of de Vries algebras and de Vries morphisms, so classical de Vries duality is recovered from the new one.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The construction yields, as a by-product, a new proof that the category of compact Hausdorff spaces is the exact completion of the category of Stone spaces.
